summary: Verified all 3 bug fixes end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (X-Forwarded-For first-IP extraction, X-Real-IP fallback via localhost bypass of k8s ingress XFF injection, IP visible to agent dashboard, queue promotion on agent online, queue promotion on agent close, public customer close endpoint success/wrong-token/idempotent/queue-promotion). Frontend: Playwright confirmed close-chat-btn appears only in phase='chat', close-confirm-dialog with cancel & confirm buttons works correctly, cancel keeps chat active, confirm transitions to closed view showing 'This chat has been closed. Thank you for contacting us!' + CSAT stars, dark theme preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: X-Real-IP fallback path in utils.get_real_client_ip is essentially unreachable through the public preview URL because the k8s ingress ALWAYS injects X-Forwarded-For. This is by design (RFC precedence), verified by testing via http://localhost:8001 to bypass the ingress. Code logic is correct.
ChatWidget.jsx is 962 lines — consider splitting phase-specific views (lily-stage, queue-view, chat-view, closed-view) into separate sub-components for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
seed_data_creation: Test purges db.sessions between test classes; agent status reset to offline; no persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter10 verified all 3 bugs (queue auto-assign on agent online + on close, real client IP via XFF/X-Real-IP, customer close endpoint + AlertDialog). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_bug_fixes.py loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. K8s ingress overrides X-Real-IP with XFF, so that fallback is tested via localhost:8001 direct hit. Queue promotion tests force-set status='queued' in DB (since MAX_ACTIVE_CHATS_PER_AGENT=20 makes natural queueing hard).
